info.name: NSI-IT-LMS API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection automatically generated from the official OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification for NSI IT LMS (Nityashree Infosystems Learning Management System).

### How to authenticate:
1. Open the 'Authentication -> User Login' request.
2. Submit with valid credentials (e.g. admin@nsiit.com / Admin@123).
3. The test script automatically saves the returned JWT token into the `{{token}}` collection variable.
4. All other requests inherit Bearer Token authorization automatically.
